name: jooble-mcp
description: Jooble (jobs): search. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

platform_mcp_jooble_api_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_JOOBLE_API_KEY
platform_mcp_jooble_api_key.description: Jooble REST API key issued after the request form on https://jooble.org/api/about; it is the last path segment of every call (POST https://jooble.org/api/{api_Key}). Each Jooble country domain has its own key; the free plan is limited to 500 requests per key in total.

tools.name: search
tools.description: POST https://jooble.org/api/{api_Key} with a JSON body: keywords, location (both documented as required by Jooble, so pass a location), page (from 1) and ResultOnPage (items per page; no documented maximum, capped here at 100). Optional documented body fields radius (0|4|8|16|26|40|80 km), salary, SearchMode and companysearch are not sent. Response: totalCount plus jobs[] {id, title, location, snippet, salary (a formatted string such as '{min} - {max} {currency}', kept in raw), source, type, link, company, updated}. Aggregator: link opens the source board. Free plan: 500 requests per key, lifetime.
